issue_title: tqdm.write crashes when sys.stdout is None
issue_body: Calling tqdm.write() crashes with AttributeError when sys.stdout has been set to None (e.g. in some GUI or frozen/packaged app environments where stdout is unavailable). Expected: tqdm.write should silently no-op instead of crashing when no output stream is available.
difficulty_notes: Easy — single guard clause added in two places (write() and external_write_mode()), brand new test function. Good second sanity-check task, slightly different shape than tqdm-0001 (guard clause vs conditional branch).
